contract.ordinarySearch: Generate all at-most-two ordinary nonidentity assignments over the 21 main keys, with E-key retroflex repair when needed. Score a deterministic screened subset plus baseline control, then descend the overall cost leaders.
contract.neighborhood: Final single moves, pair swaps, key-group swaps, and A/E/O single or co-key group moves. Prioritize b/n lane and overall lane, alternating axes. Finite search.
